description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

signal_window_gmt.note: Signals are only generated during this pre-market window (GMT). If the routine starts outside this window, post a warning and exit without analysis.

macro_kill_switches.note_vix_zone: VIX 20-25 restricts signals to HIGH confidence only (5-6/6). VIX > vix_max triggers full kill-switch.

earnings.note: After blackout ends, raise confluence bar to 5/6 for post_earnings_elevated_bar_days trading day(s) to avoid gap reversals.
